description: Synthetic system of record for a commercial bank's client book across four lines of business (Corporate Banking, Commercial Lending, Capital Markets, Global Markets). Normalized: every child collection links to clients by clientId. This is the source data that widgets are built from.
conventions: Each document's _id equals its business key (clientId, holdingId, ...). Join on the business key fields.
All money amounts are US dollars; their field names end in Usd.
All dates are UTC BSON dates. _meta.asOfDate is 'today' for this dataset; use it, not the wall clock, for 'YTD', 'overdue', 'next 90 days' and similar.
Revenue is booked monthly after month-end close: revenue_monthly holds the 24 closed months before asOfDate, so the current month is never present.

Fields that do not apply to a document are omitted, not null (for example drawnUsd only exists on credit holdings). Exception: precall_ collections mirror source workbooks, so a blank source value is stored as null.
precall_ collections hold KPI measures one per row (metricName verbatim, metricValue as supplied): filter on metricName and do not assume measures share a unit or scale.
Values such as healthScore, walletSizeUsd and headroomPct are supplied by upstream bank systems. Metrics under derivedMetrics are not stored and must be computed.

collections.clients: One row per client relationship (the anchor of Client 360).
collections.products: Reference list of every product the bank sells. Used for cross-sell whitespace.
collections.holdings: Products a client currently holds: facilities, deposit accounts, hedges, treasury services, completed capital markets mandates.
collections.revenue_monthly: Monthly revenue fact per holding: net interest income plus fees.
collections.covenants: Financial covenants on credit holdings, with the latest test result.
collections.opportunities: Sales pipeline: open and closed deals.
collections.signals: Detected risk, opportunity, service and market signals, and their triage stage.
collections.contacts: People at the client the bank deals with.
collections.activities: Interactions logged by the coverage team (meetings, calls, credit reviews, ...).
collections.precall_company_profiles: Pre-call brief: one company profile per client (firmographics as attributes). Parent of the other precall_ collections.
collections.precall_citizens_products: Pre-call brief: Citizens products the client holds, with balances, limits and revenue.
collections.precall_citizens_coverage: Pre-call brief: Citizens coverage bankers and their roles.
collections.precall_citizens_relationship_kpis: Pre-call brief: Citizens relationship profitability measures (RORC, ...) by as-of date, one measure per row.
collections.precall_company_financial_kpis: Pre-call brief: the company's financial measures (revenue, EBITDA, leverage, ...) by statement period, one measure per row.
collections.precall_company_contacts: Pre-call brief: contacts at the company as the source holds them, including former ones.
collections.precall_company_event_history: Pre-call brief: recorded events and interactions with free-text outcomes.
collections.precall_company_risk_rating_history: Pre-call brief: internal PD-risk rating history per legal entity.

joins: clients.clientId 1 - n holdings.clientId, revenue_monthly.clientId, covenants.clientId, opportunities.clientId, signals.clientId, contacts.clientId, activities.clientId
clients.clientId 1 - 1 precall_company_profiles.clientId; precall_company_profiles.clientId 1 - n every other precall_ collection's clientId

description: Reference list of the bank's products, one row per product. Static.

fields.name: lob
fields.description: Line of business that owns the product.

fields.name: productType
fields.description: Economic type. It decides which amount fields a holding has and how it earns revenue: credit (committedUsd/drawnUsd; NII on drawn plus commitment fees), deposit (balanceUsd; NII margin), treasury (fees only, no balance), markets (notionalUsd; trading fees), capital_markets (notionalUsd = deal size; one-off fee on completion).

fields.name: description
fields.description: One-line plain-English description of the product.

description: Commercial banking clients: who they are, how they are covered, how risky they are. Bank economics (exposure, revenue, deposits, pipeline) are NOT stored here; derive them from holdings, revenue_monthly and opportunities.

fields.name: industry
fields.description: Industry sector. Use it to group peers.

fields.name: segment
fields.description: Primary line of business that owns coverage of the client.

fields.name: tier
fields.description: Coverage tier by relationship size and importance.

fields.name: relationshipManager
fields.description: Name of the relationship manager (also the 'Relationship Manager' entry in coverageTeam).

fields.name: coverageTeam
fields.description: Bankers covering the client: one per role.

fields.name: healthScore
fields.description: Relationship health from the bank's relationship model, 0-100 (higher is better). It falls with covenant breaches, active P1 risk signals, overdue KYC and declining revenue. Usual bands: >=75 healthy, 50-74 watch, <50 at risk.

fields.name: esgScore
fields.description: ESG score from a third-party provider, 0-100 (higher is better).

fields.name: annualRevenueUsd
fields.description: The client's own annual revenue (company size), not revenue the bank earns.

fields.name: walletSizeUsd
fields.description: Estimated total annual banking spend of the client across all banks (its 'wallet'). Compare it with trailing-12-month revenue for share of wallet.

fields.name: kycStatus
fields.description: Know-your-customer refresh status. Overdue blocks new business.

fields.name: nextReviewDate
fields.description: Next scheduled annual relationship / credit review.

derivedMetrics.name: totalExposureUsd
derivedMetrics.definition: Sum of holdings.drawnUsd where productType = 'credit' for the client.

derivedMetrics.name: committedLimitUsd
derivedMetrics.definition: Sum of holdings.committedUsd where productType = 'credit' for the client.

derivedMetrics.name: utilization
derivedMetrics.definition: totalExposureUsd / committedLimitUsd (0-1). Above 0.9 on revolving lines is a warning sign.

derivedMetrics.name: depositsUsd
derivedMetrics.definition: Sum of holdings.balanceUsd where productType = 'deposit' for the client.

derivedMetrics.name: revenueYtdUsd
derivedMetrics.definition: Sum of revenue_monthly.totalUsd for the client with month in the calendar year of _meta.asOfDate.

derivedMetrics.name: revenuePriorYtdUsd
derivedMetrics.definition: Sum of revenue_monthly.totalUsd for the same months of the previous calendar year (January up to the latest closed month, one year earlier).

derivedMetrics.name: revenueYoY
derivedMetrics.definition: (revenueYtdUsd - revenuePriorYtdUsd) / revenuePriorYtdUsd.

derivedMetrics.name: niiYtdUsd / feeYtdUsd
derivedMetrics.definition: Same as revenueYtdUsd, summing niiUsd or feeUsd instead of totalUsd.

derivedMetrics.name: revenueT12mUsd
derivedMetrics.definition: Sum of revenue_monthly.totalUsd over the 12 most recent closed months.

derivedMetrics.name: shareOfWallet
derivedMetrics.definition: revenueT12mUsd / clients.walletSizeUsd (0-1).

derivedMetrics.name: walletGapUsd
derivedMetrics.definition: walletSizeUsd - revenueT12mUsd: revenue the client spends with other banks.

derivedMetrics.name: revenueByLob
derivedMetrics.definition: revenue_monthly grouped by lob (for example YTD or T12M).

derivedMetrics.name: revenueTrendQuarterly
derivedMetrics.definition: revenue_monthly grouped by calendar quarter of month; the last 8 quarters cover the 24 months stored.

derivedMetrics.name: openPipelineUsd
derivedMetrics.definition: Sum of opportunities.expectedRevenueUsd where stage is not 'Closed Won' or 'Closed Lost'.

derivedMetrics.name: activeSignals
derivedMetrics.definition: Count of signals where stage != 'Resolved' (often split by severity).

derivedMetrics.name: crossSellWhitespace
derivedMetrics.definition: products whose productId is not among the client's holdings.productId.

derivedMetrics.name: peerAverages
derivedMetrics.definition: Averages of a client metric over clients with the same industry (for example avg healthScore, avg shareOfWallet).

description: Products each client holds with the bank, with their current amounts as of _meta.asOfDate. Which amount fields are present depends on productType.
grain: one row per client product holding (facility, account, hedge program, service or completed mandate)

fields.name: status
fields.description: Pending = approved but not yet funded or live (no revenue yet). Maturing = matures within 180 days of asOfDate. Completed = a capital_markets mandate that has closed (its fee is booked in the completion month).

fields.name: openedDate
fields.description: Date the holding was opened or funded. For capital_markets it is the deal completion date.

fields.name: maturityDate
fields.description: Contractual maturity. Present on credit and markets holdings only.

fields.name: committedUsd
fields.description: Committed facility limit. Present on credit holdings only.

fields.name: drawnUsd
fields.description: Outstanding drawn balance (the credit exposure). Present on credit holdings only; always <= committedUsd.

fields.name: balanceUsd
fields.description: Current deposit balance. Present on deposit holdings only.

fields.name: notionalUsd
fields.description: Hedge notional (markets) or deal size (capital_markets). Not a balance-sheet amount.

derivedMetrics.name: utilization
derivedMetrics.definition: drawnUsd / committedUsd for a credit holding.

derivedMetrics.name: daysToMaturity
derivedMetrics.definition: maturityDate - _meta.asOfDate in days.

description: Revenue the bank earned, per holding per closed month, for the 24 closed months before _meta.asOfDate. Months with zero revenue for a holding have no row. This is the source of every revenue figure: YTD, trend, by LOB, NII vs fees.
grain: one row per holding per month

fields.name: lob
fields.description: Line of business credited with the revenue.

fields.name: month
fields.description: First day (UTC) of the revenue month.

fields.name: niiUsd
fields.description: Net interest income for the month (spread on loans, margin on deposits).

fields.name: feeUsd
fields.description: Fee income for the month (commitment, arrangement, service, trading, underwriting and advisory fees).

derivedMetrics.name: quarter
derivedMetrics.definition: Calendar quarter of month: year + '-Q' + ceil(monthNumber / 3).

description: Financial covenants attached to credit holdings (Commercial Lending and Capital Markets loans), with the result of the latest quarterly test.
grain: one row per covenant on a credit holding

fields.name: holdingId
fields.description: Credit facility the covenant belongs to.

fields.name: metric
fields.description: Financial ratio or amount being tested.

fields.name: operator
fields.description: Direction of the test: the actual must be <= or >= the threshold.

fields.name: actual
fields.description: Value at the last test, in unit.

fields.name: unit
fields.description: Unit of threshold and actual: x = multiple, % = percent (70 means 70%), USD = dollars.

fields.name: headroomPct
fields.description: Distance from the limit in percent of the threshold. For <=: (threshold - actual) / threshold * 100. For >=: (actual - threshold) / threshold * 100. Negative means breached.

fields.name: status
fields.description: Breach if headroomPct < 0, Watch if headroomPct < 15, otherwise Compliant.

fields.name: testFrequency
fields.description: How often the covenant is tested.

fields.name: lastTestDate
fields.description: Quarter-end date of the latest test.

description: Sales pipeline across all lines of business: open deals and deals closed in the last year.

fields.name: lob
fields.description: Line of business of the product.

fields.name: stage
fields.description: Sales stage. Open stages in order: Discovery, Proposal, Structuring, Credit Approval, Documentation, Closing.

fields.name: probability
fields.description: Win probability, fixed by stage: Discovery 10, Proposal 25, Structuring 40, Credit Approval 60, Documentation 80, Closing 90, Closed Won 100, Closed Lost 0.

fields.name: forecastCategory
fields.description: Commit if probability >= 80, Best Case if >= 40, otherwise Pipeline; Closed for closed deals.

fields.name: dealSizeUsd
fields.description: Facility size, notional or balance of the deal (annual contract value for treasury services). This is NOT revenue.

fields.name: expectedRevenueUsd
fields.description: Expected first-year revenue to the bank if won. This is the pipeline value.

fields.name: closeDate
fields.description: Expected close date (open deals) or actual close date (closed deals).

fields.name: originalCloseDate
fields.description: Close date first forecast. Earlier than closeDate when the deal has slipped.

fields.name: riskLevel
fields.description: Deal execution risk assessed by the owner.

fields.name: daysInStage
fields.description: Days since the deal entered its current stage (0 for closed deals).

fields.name: nextStep
fields.description: Next action. Present on open deals only.

fields.name: blockers
fields.description: Workstreams holding the deal up. May be empty.

derivedMetrics.name: isOpen
derivedMetrics.definition: stage is not 'Closed Won' or 'Closed Lost'.

derivedMetrics.name: slipped
derivedMetrics.definition: isOpen and closeDate < _meta.asOfDate (past due), or closeDate > originalCloseDate (pushed out).

derivedMetrics.name: stalled
derivedMetrics.definition: isOpen and daysInStage > 45.

derivedMetrics.name: weightedPipelineUsd
derivedMetrics.definition: Sum of expectedRevenueUsd * probability / 100 over open deals.

derivedMetrics.name: winRate
derivedMetrics.definition: Closed Won count / (Closed Won + Closed Lost) count over a period.

description: Signals detected about a client by bank systems (credit monitoring, payments flows, CRM, service desk, news, market data), with their triage stage. Some are linked to the holding, covenant or opportunity they concern.

fields.name: severity
fields.description: Urgency: P1 = act today, P2 = this week, P3 = informational.

fields.name: stage
fields.description: Triage stage, in order New, Triaged, Engaged, Actioned, Resolved. Every stage except Resolved counts as active.

fields.name: impactUsd
fields.description: Estimated dollars at stake: exposure at risk for Risk signals, revenue potential for Opportunity signals.

fields.name: holdingId
fields.description: Holding the signal is about, if any.

fields.name: covenantId
fields.description: Covenant the signal is about, if any.

fields.name: evidence
fields.description: Data points supporting the signal, preformatted for display.

fields.name: recommendedActions
fields.description: Suggested next best actions, in priority order.

derivedMetrics.name: isActive
derivedMetrics.definition: stage != 'Resolved'.

description: People at each client that the coverage team deals with.

fields.name: isPrimary
fields.description: True for the primary contact (one per client).

fields.name: lastContactDate
fields.description: Date of the most recent logged activity with this person.

description: Interactions logged by the coverage team over the 180 days before asOfDate.

fields.name: contactId
fields.description: Client contact involved. Absent for internal activities such as credit reviews.

description: Pre-call brief: one company profile per client, with its firmographics. Synthetic seed shaped like the bank's pre-call workbooks: values are held as the workbook holds them, not normalized; blank source values are null.

fields.name: _id
fields.description: Synthetic document key: a company prefix and the source pr_id.

fields.name: clientId
fields.description: Parent key for every precall_ child collection: clients.clientId.

fields.name: sourcePrId
fields.description: Source pr_id: the workbook's client id.

fields.name: privatePublicIndicator
fields.description: Source private_public_ind; null when blank in the workbook - do not infer the company type.

fields.name: attributes
fields.description: Remaining firmographic attributes keyed by their source names (ticker, bank_role, NAICS, naics_description, employee_size, annual_revenue, hq_city, hq_country, MARKETCAP, HIGH_52_WEEK, PRICEHIGH, PRICINGDATE). Values keep their source meaning; public-market attributes are null for private companies.

description: Pre-call brief: the Citizens products the client holds, one row per product, with balances and revenue. Synthetic seed shaped like the bank's pre-call workbooks: values are held as the workbook holds them, not normalized; blank source values are null.
grain: one row per client per product

fields.name: _id
fields.description: Synthetic row key: the client's profile _id, a tag and a row number (e.g. VANTAGE-12345-PRD-0001).

fields.name: sourcePrId
fields.description: Source pr_id: the workbook's client id, retained as a string.

fields.name: partyCount
fields.description: Source party_count: legal entities on the product.

fields.name: arrangementCount
fields.description: Source arrangement_count: accounts or arrangements under the product.

fields.name: totalBalance
fields.description: Source total_balance: drawn for credit, balance for deposits, notional for markets and capital markets; null for fee-only products. Currency/units are not supplied in the worksheet.

fields.name: creditLimit
fields.description: Source credit_limit: committed amount, credit products only; grain and currency require business confirmation.

fields.name: availableBalance
fields.description: Source available_balance: undrawn commitment for credit, balance for deposits.

fields.name: revenue
fields.description: Source product revenue (trailing twelve months in this seed); period and currency require confirmation.

description: Pre-call brief: the Citizens employees covering the client and their coverage roles. Synthetic seed shaped like the bank's pre-call workbooks: values are held as the workbook holds them, not normalized; blank source values are null.
grain: one row per employee per coverage assignment

fields.name: _id
fields.description: Synthetic row key: the client's profile _id, a tag and a row number (e.g. VANTAGE-12345-PRD-0001).

fields.name: sourcePrId
fields.description: Source pr_id: the workbook's client id, retained as a string.

fields.name: employeeId
fields.description: Source employee_id, retained as a string identifier.

description: Pre-call brief: Citizens relationship profitability measures, one row per measure per reporting date. This is Citizens' relationship economics, not the company's own financial performance. Synthetic seed shaped like the bank's pre-call workbooks: values are held as the workbook holds them, not normalized; blank source values are null.
grain: one row per client per measure per as-of date (monthly, 24 months)

fields.name: _id
fields.description: Synthetic row key: the client's profile _id, a tag and a row number (e.g. VANTAGE-12345-PRD-0001).

fields.name: sourcePrId
fields.description: Source pr_id: the workbook's client id, retained as a string.

fields.name: metricName
fields.description: Source cpr_kpi_name, preserved verbatim. Measures are separate observations: do not treat net interest income as net interest margin, or assume all measures share a scale.
allowedValues: net interest income - loans and leases

fields.name: metricValue
fields.description: Source cpr_kpi_value; no currency, scale or semantic conversion applied (RORC values are percents, income values are monthly USD).

description: Pre-call brief: the company's financial measures from its spread statements, one row per measure per statement period. Synthetic seed shaped like the bank's pre-call workbooks: values are held as the workbook holds them, not normalized; blank source values are null.
grain: one row per client per measure per statement (three fiscal years and the trailing twelve months)

fields.name: _id
fields.description: Synthetic row key: the client's profile _id, a tag and a row number (e.g. VANTAGE-12345-PRD-0001).

fields.name: sourcePrId
fields.description: Source pr_id: the workbook's client id, retained as a string.

fields.name: sourceCustomerId
fields.description: Source customerid, retained as a string identifier.

fields.name: metricValue
fields.description: Source financial_kpi_value; no currency or scale conversion applied (amounts in USD, *_rt ratios as multiples, dso/dio/dpo in days). Null when missing in the source; zero only when the source says zero.

description: Pre-call brief: contacts at the company as the source holds them. Duplicate and historical rows are preserved (some are marked as no longer with the company); no de-duplication. Synthetic seed shaped like the bank's pre-call workbooks: values are held as the workbook holds them, not normalized; blank source values are null.
grain: one row per source contact row

fields.name: _id
fields.description: Synthetic row key: the client's profile _id, a tag and a row number (e.g. VANTAGE-12345-PRD-0001).

fields.name: sourcePrId
fields.description: Source pr_id: the workbook's client id, retained as a string.

fields.name: role
fields.description: Source role; may be missing or a stale-status label such as 'No longer with company'.

description: Pre-call brief: recorded client events and interactions, with free-text notes retained as records (not approved facts). Synthetic seed shaped like the bank's pre-call workbooks: values are held as the workbook holds them, not normalized; blank source values are null.
grain: one row per event or interaction

fields.name: _id
fields.description: Synthetic row key: the client's profile _id, a tag and a row number (e.g. VANTAGE-12345-PRD-0001).

fields.name: sourcePrId
fields.description: Source pr_id: the workbook's client id, retained as a string.

fields.name: attendee
fields.description: Source attendee: the client contact, null for internal events.

description: Pre-call brief: internal PD-risk observations per legal entity and quarter. These are Citizens internal risk data, not agency ratings. Synthetic seed shaped like the bank's pre-call workbooks: values are held as the workbook holds them, not normalized; blank source values are null.
grain: one row per legal entity per measurement period (last six quarters)

fields.name: _id
fields.description: Synthetic row key: the client's profile _id, RSK and a row number.

fields.name: involvedPartyId
fields.description: Source INVOLVED_PARTY_ID, retained as a string identifier.

fields.name: primaryLegalEntityFlag
fields.description: Source PRIMARY_LE_FLAG when supplied (clients with more than one rated entity); null otherwise.

fields.name: pdRatingCode
fields.description: Source PD_RATING_CD: internal code (1 best - 9 worst), not an agency grade.

fields.name: defaultProbability
fields.description: Source PDFT_FINAL_SET_POINT_ORA_RT: probability of default as a fraction, as supplied.

fields.name: approvingEmployeeId
fields.description: Source PD_APPROVING_EMPLOYEE_NUM: the approving credit officer (precall_citizens_coverage.employeeId).
